name: Defender Handoff Reduction & Picker Simplification
changes: Removes the copied NewzDeckUpdateHandoff executable from About & Updates; the checksum-verified Setup EXE is now launched directly in the signed-in Windows session.
Reduces NewzDeckPicker.exe to folder-selection duties only. Update handoff, browser-window control, process launching, and taskbar compatibility modes are removed from Picker source.
Moves the narrow --close-app-windows maintenance mode to the already-installed NewzDeck launcher, which already owns Chromium app-window discovery for taskbar identity.

Updates Setup so it never launches NewzDeckPicker.exe during upgrade. After file overlay, Setup asks the new launcher to close any remaining NewzDeck Chromium app window, then restores service/tray state and relaunches normally.
Preserves SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31, Automation/Wanted/Smart Import behavior, Newsgroup Browser behavior, and the Defender-accepted yEnc helper pipeline.
regression_guards: NewzDeckPicker.go must remain folder-picker-only and may not contain --update-handoff, --close-app-windows, os/exec, ShellExecuteExW, or browser/process enumeration code.
server.py may not create or execute NewzDeckUpdateHandoff temporary executables; verified online updates must launch the staged Setup directly.
NewzDeck.iss may not execute NewzDeckPicker.exe during upgrade; post-overlay browser-window close must use NewzDeck.exe --close-app-windows.
NewzDeckLauncher.go must retain the bounded --close-app-windows mode and the existing taskbar/window ownership logic.
The Picker retains normal Go build metadata (-H windowsgui) while the pinned Defender-accepted yEnc LF/Linux binary remains unchanged.
